prompt: Markets have been pretty shaky lately and Nifty looks weak. Are there still any swing trades worth taking right now, or should I just sit on my hands this month? Looking for that 5% kind of move.

assertions.text: Leads with an explicit Nifty market-regime assessment (vs 20/50 DMA, India VIX).
If the regime is weak, is willing to recommend sitting out or returns few/no names under stricter criteria.
Frames the elevated risk of swing longs when the broad market is weak.
Any named stock still gets a full trade plan with a stop-loss.
